name: ci-watch
description: After every git push, follows the GitHub Actions runs (via gh) until they finish; with an open pull request (also after gh pr create, or /ci pr <nr>) all its checks, other CI included, and whether it is ready to merge. On red it shows the failed step log.

intervalSec.title: CI Watch: poll every … seconds
intervalSec.description: How often gh is asked for the state of the runs.

onRed.title: CI Watch: on red
onRed.description: pane: open the log pane. prompt: put an analysis request into the prompt (not sent). both.

sound.title: CI Watch: sound
sound.description: on: a short sound when the runs are green or red (Windows: system sounds).

notify.title: CI Watch: system notification
notify.description: When a watched run ends, through your notification channel (preferredNotifChannel): off, only red, or always. Claude Code notifies at the end of a turn; CI usually ends later.

prOnDesktop.title: CI Watch: PR checks in the desktop app
prOnDesktop.description: app: in the desktop app a new PR is watched by the app itself (CI bar, auto-fix), so nothing is reported twice; pushes are still watched here. box: CI Watch follows the PR as in the terminal.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the texts this mod shows and writes.
